name: Purified
storyline:
AN UNHOLY SIEGE ON HUMANITY'S FINAL CITY

Cybernetic sinners and infernal beasts claw at the walls of Megido, mankind's last remaining bastion, and the holy army has but one last resort: You!
Slash with your righteous blade, dash on borrowed angel's wings, and grant sweet .50 caliber death to those fallen from grace!

"May only the vigilant and [REDACTED] see the heavens, so speak the Voice Almighty!"
summary:
PURIFIED is a single-player, third-person shooter with high octane action and neo-retro style, currently in development for the PS Vita and PC.
Inspired by the games and comics of the 90s and early 00s, it aims to be both a love letter to, and commentary on, the era of giant shoulder armor and over-the-top action.
